issues.description: The specification/UML defines an inventory class named "Stock" (with methods add, take, findStockIngredient, addToStockIngredients, emptyStock) and states that SealSaloon has a (static) field named stock of type Stock. In both template and solution, this functionality is implemented in a class named Inventory, while Stock.java exists but is empty. This creates ambiguity for students about which class they must implement/modify (Stock vs Inventory) to satisfy the UML and required method set.
issues.suggestedFix: Make naming consistent across all artifacts: either rename Inventory to Stock (and update SealSaloon to use Stock and provide getStock(): Stock), or update the problem statement/UML to use Inventory instead of Stock and remove Stock.java from the starter.
